answer_rules.accept_meaning: Accept the meaning, not exact words. 'Chaha beku' and 'Nanage chaha beku' are both right.

accept_any_spelling.rule: Accept any spelling, and English words mixed into Kannada.

answer_rules.never_show_wrong: Never show 'Wrong'. The NPC reacts naturally, then one short tip appears.
answer_rules.tip: The tip is the quest's quick_hint.
answer_rules.default_reaction: If an answer is not accepted and has no reaction_id, the NPC uses r_puzzled — except Somanna, who uses r_somanna_ignores for English.

error_categories.description: Real Kannada, but not what this moment needs (e.g. 'Beku' instead of 'Dhanyavada').
Want and don't-want mixed up (e.g. 'Nanage chaha beda' when ordering).
Blunt form used with an elder (e.g. 'Bagilu tegi' instead of 'Svalpa bagilu tegeyiri').
Misunderstood what the NPC said (e.g. naming the wrong person in Quest 2.2).
Misunderstood a number (e.g. typing 'Hattu' when Shanthakka asks for 'aivattu').

reactions.speaker: somanna
reactions.action: frowns and turns away until asked politely
